page.overview:
What is Aphrodite?

Aphrodite (), also known as Venus, was a multispheric interloper deity of love, beauty, partially due to the ballad Seasons of Love.

The avatars of Aphrodite could vary widely in appearance, though they were always said to be incredibly beautiful and usually in the form of a woman. In her true form, Aphrodite appeared as a human woman of astonishing beauty, dressed in a simple gown and adorned with jewelry.

Aphrodite was a chaotic good deity, embodying chaotic joy of passion, freedom, and wisdom. She could usually be seen smiling, giving way to the commonly said monikers "smile-loving" and "laughter-loving". She promoted the ideals of good, but did not demand the same of others, and celebrated the beauty of life in all its forms.

Aphrodite was also known to have a penchant for extreme vanity and jealousy, with her vainness among deities of the multiverse rivaled only by the goddess Sune. She occasionally struck against mortals that she overheard audaciously claiming that their charm surpasses her own.
